claim: Linear probes on agent residual streams decode full correctness of the evolving program with AUC up to 0.83 and transfer across SWE-Bench Verified and Pro.
stance_target: probes read program correctness in agentic settings
quoted_support: a logistic-regression probe on hidden states is able to decode whether the current code parses, passes its test suite, reduces the number of failing tests, and introduces regressions, reaching AUC up to 0.83 for correctness across two models and two benchmarks.

breadth.confidence_families: linear (logistic regression) residual-stream probes on hidden states (Sec 3.4); no verbal or sampled readouts
breadth.reasoning_models: not present (agent models; reasoning flag not analyzed)
breadth.benchmarks: SWE-Bench-Verified 500 tasks, SWE-Bench-Pro 731 tasks, up to 10 trajectories per task (Sec 3.6)
breadth.label_source: parse/compile, test suite oracle, failing-test count decrease, regression of initially passing tests (Sec 3.3)
breadth.calibration_metrics: AUC-ROC primary; claims probes are 'calibrated' in contributions (Sec 1) but no ECE/Brier located
breadth.granularity: per-step program state, future horizon k up to 50 steps; test-suite-level properties (full, partial, regression)
breadth.causal_intervention: shuffled-label control (AUC 0.50), cross-benchmark transfer (Fig 5); no steering
